plan.title: feat(review-cycle,swarm): standing residual until resolved conf floor or same-fingerprint loop

narratives.Description: feat(review-cycle,swarm): standing residual until resolved conf floor or same-fingerprint loop
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`#3273` made dual-stop resume discoverable, but **pursue residual** is still **one pass then park**. A through-merge / drive-to:merge-ready cohort then leaves PRs sitting at **below the resolved Greptile floor** when the bot still names **one leftover on files the PR already touches**.

That reading is wrong for **directive dogfood (5/5)** and for **consumers** (default **4/5**, or whatever `plan.policy.review.minGreptileConfidence` is). The floor is already resolved by `#3095`. The missing rule is **when to keep going** vs **when to park**.

Field class (2026-08-18, deftai/directive): after `pursue residuals until told otherwise or an endless loop`, the parent kept moving CI-red / dirty PRs and **parked** PR 3432 and PR 3408 at 4/5. Both had a single concrete leftover on already-touched files. The operator had to re-point: work those until 5/5 or loop.

## Problem

Three rules collide and no skill says which wins:

| Rule | What an agent does |
|------|--------------------|
| Dogfood / `#3095` floor | PR is not CLEAN below resolved `minGreptileConfidence` |
| `#3273` | `pursue residual` = **one** pass on the unit that just dual-stopped, then re-stop |
| `#2881` | Confidence-only hold (0 P0/P1) = at most one polish; out-of-AC = follow-up issue, do not expand |

So a standing order like **pursue residuals until a loop** gets read as **only new leftovers** (CI red, dirty rebase, operator-named hole). A 4/5 (or consumer 3/5) PR with one named file leftover waits for the human to re-point.

`#2881` also over-fires: **dropped return value / wrong remediation on a file this PR already owns** gets labeled new-subsystem and parked. The P0 carve-out (defect on already-touched files) should have won.

## Goals

1. **Portable floor.** Keep going until confidence meets the **resolved** `#3095` floor (`plan.policy.review.minGreptileConfidence`: typed project policy > framework-source dogfood **5** > consumer default **4`). ⊗ Hard-code 5/5. ⊗ Lower the project policy to clear one PR.
2. **Typed leftovers** so park vs continue is not invented:
   - **A — named leftover on already-touched files** (wrong remediation, dropped field, fixture, same-module hole) → **in-AC residual**. Keep going until floor or same-fingerprint loop.
   - **B — new subsystem / AC fight** → park or file a follow-up. Do not expand mid-babysit.
   - **C — score-only, no concrete finding** → document / same-as-conf-hold / operator floor for this PR only (`#3273` step 3). Not unbounded redesign.
3. **Standing-order shape** distinct from one-shot `pursue residual`:
   - One-shot: one pass, then re-stop (`#3273` today).
   - Standing: **until resolved floor or same primary fingerprint repeats** (and/or dual-stop batch cap). Applies to **every open unit in the active cohort / ordered plan**, not only the PR that just halted.
4. **Same-fingerprint halt** is the endless-loop stop. A *new* leftover after a real fix may take another batch (still capped by `#2442`).
5. **Consumer + maintainer.** Same deposit skills. Works when the floor is 4, 5, or a project override. No `deftai/directive`-only path.
6. **Low-token.** Extend the existing `#3273` / `#2881` sections. No new skill, no new verb.

## Non-goals

- Removing dual-stop or auto-retry forever
- Silent edit of `minGreptileConfidence`
- Treating every 4/5 prose complaint as a new story
- Parent self-implement after a merge-ready leaf (`#2843` / `#3032`)

## Recommended KISS fix

In `deft-directive-review-cycle` and `deft-directive-swarm` § Operator follow-up after dual-stop (`#3273`) + Out-of-AC (`#2881`):

1. Add the A/B/C leftover classes (one short table).
2. Name the standing-order phrases: **until floor or loop** / **until greptile meets policy** / **pursue residuals until told otherwise** → class A units keep moving to the **resolved** floor; class B/C stay parked unless the operator names them.
3. One-shot `pursue residual` stays one pass (do not silently widen `#3273`).
4. `#2881` P0 carve-out: a leftover on **files already in the PR** is class A unless it needs a new ledger/protocol/story.
5. Halt-report resume line: include leftover class + resolved floor + whether standing-order is active.
6. Content-contract tests for the markers. CHANGELOG process/skills note.

Inspect floor with existing `task policy:show --field=minGreptileConfidence` / `deft policy:show --field=minGreptileConfidence`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] **AC1** Review-cycle + swarm `#3273` / `#2881` text names leftover classes A/B/C and which ones auto-continue.
- [ ] **AC2** Continue-until target is the **resolved `#3095` floor**, not a hard-coded 5. Consumer default 4, dogfood 5, project override honored. Tests or fixtures assert the wording is floor-relative.
- [ ] **AC3** Standing-order phrases are distinct from one-shot `pursue residual` and apply to open cohort/plan units, not only the last halted PR.
- [ ] **AC4** Same-fingerprint halt is the loop stop; `#2442` batch cap still applies.
- [ ] **AC5** `#2881` carve-out: already-touched-file leftover is class A (in-AC residual), not new-subsystem by default.
- [ ] **AC6** Portable: consumer deposit + maintainer tree; dual-invoke `task` / `deft`; no framework-monorepo-only required path.
- [ ] **AC7** Halt-report resume line includes leftover class + resolved floor + standing vs one-shot.
- [ ] **AC8** CHANGELOG cites this issue under process/skills.
- [ ] **AC9** Skill/content-contract tests assert the new markers (same pattern as `#3273`).

## Refs

- #2881 out-of-AC / conf-only holds
- #3095 minGreptileConfidence (policy > dogfood 5 > consumer 4)
- #3225 advisory should-not-merge
- #3273 operator follow-up after dual-stop (one residual pass)
- #2442 dual stop
- #3265 thin fail-closed
- Field: PR 3432 / PR 3408 parked at 4/5 until operator re-pointed (2026-08-18)
narratives.UserStory: As a through-merge parent on directive or a consumer, I want residual follow-up to keep going until the resolved Greptile floor or the same leftover fingerprint repeats, so parked 4/5 (or consumer 3/5) PRs with one named leftover on already-touched files do not wait for a second human re-point.
